package: JST PH series SMT shrouded header, SIDE ENTRY (right-angle), 10 circuits, 2.0 mm pitch, SM4 surface-mount type, embossed tape (TB), (LF)(SN) lead-free tin label
description: JST PH CONNECTOR catalog (2.0 mm pitch, disconnectable crimp style), 'SMT type shrouded header' table on page 3: S10B-PH-SM4-TB is the SIDE ENTRY type with 10 circuits (the B-prefix column, B10B-PH-SM4-TB, is the top entry type). Page-3 dimension table row for 10 circuits: A = 18.0 mm (= 2.0 x (10-1), first-to-last circuit span), B = 23.9 mm for the side entry type (23.95 mm for top entry); the side-entry body figure gives 2.95 mm from each end of B to the A datum, wafer height 5.5 mm, depth 6 mm plus a (2.6) reference, plus 2.4 and 1.6 mm details. Series specifications (page 1): current rating 2 A AC/DC with AWG #24, voltage rating 100 V AC/DC, temperature range -25 C to +85 C (including temperature rise under current), contact resistance 10 mOhm max initial / 20 mOhm max after environmental testing, insulation resistance 1000 MOhm min, withstanding voltage 800 V AC for 1 minute, applicable wire AWG #32 to #24, applicable PC board thickness 0.8 to 1.6 mm, RoHS compliant. Standards: UL Recognized E60389, CSA Certified LR20812, TUV R75087. Material and finish (page 3, SMT type): post copper alloy, copper-undercoated, tin-plated (reflow treatment); wafer PA, UL94V-0, natural (ivory); solder tab brass, copper-undercoated, tin-plated (reflow treatment). Mating housing is PHR-10 (PA66, UL94V-0, natural white) with SPH-002T-P0.5S / SPH-002T-P0.5L / SPH-004T-P0.5S phosphor-bronze tin-plated crimp contacts. EXTRACTION NOTE: every dimension number in this PDF is drawn in a non-embedded Adobe-Japan1 Identity-H CID font and renders BLANK in a normal PDF rasteriser; the values below were recovered by decoding the CID stream (CID = ASCII - 31) with per-glyph device coordinates and cross-checked against the drawing's own vector geometry (see land_pattern notes).

land_pattern.package: JST 'SMT type (viewed from component side)' / 'SM4 type / Side entry type' recommended PCB layout, page 1
land_pattern.notes: SMD part - NO DRILL. From the page-1 'SMT type (viewed from component side)' drawing, SM4 side entry view. All dimensions are referenced to the horizontal datum labelled 'End face of wafer on the mating side'. PRINTED VALUES: circuit pitch 2 +/-0.05 mm; solder-tab pad width 1.5 +/-0.1 mm; solder-tab pad length 3.4 +/-0.1 mm; 1.6 +/-0.1 mm from the inboard edge of each solder-tab pad to the centre of the adjacent end circuit; 0.2 mm from the wafer end face out to the outboard edge of the solder-tab pads; 5.5 max from the wafer end face to the near edge of the circuit pads; 9 min from the wafer end face to the far edge of the circuit pads; circuit pad width 1 min. DERIVED (arithmetic on the printed values, and confirmed by measuring the drawing's own vector rectangles against the 2.0 mm pitch: 4.854 pt/mm, every pad within 0.001 mm): circuit pad 1.0 x 3.5 mm (9 - 5.5 = 3.5); solder-tab pad 1.5 x 3.4 mm; circuit-pad row centre 7.25 mm from the wafer end face, solder-tab row centre 1.5 mm from it, hence row_spacing_mm 5.75 mm centre-to-centre; total land depth 9.2 mm; circuit span 2.0 x 9 = 18.0 mm (agrees with page-3 dim A for 10 circuits); solder-tab outer-edge to outer-edge 18.0 + 2 x (1.6 + 1.5) = 24.2 mm. pad_count 12 = 10 circuit pads + 2 solder-tab pads (both are copper, so fp_verify will count 12). pad_size_mm records the CIRCUIT pad only. Drawing note: 'Tolerances are non-cumulative: +/-0.05mm for all centers' and 'The dimensions above should serve as a guideline. Contact JST for details.'

layout_notes: SIDE ENTRY = right-angle: the mating wire bundle leaves parallel to the PCB. Verified from page 3, where the table's 'Model No.' column is split 'Top entry type' (B10B-PH-SM4-TB) / 'Side entry type' (S10B-PH-SM4-TB) and the two body figures are captioned accordingly.

The land pattern is asymmetric front-to-back: the two solder tabs sit on the MATING side of the circuit row (0.2 mm beyond the wafer end face) and the 10 circuit pads sit 5.5 to 9.0 mm behind it. Placing the footprint mirrored puts the connector opening on the wrong side of the board edge.

The 8.0 mm height / 4.5 mm width blurb on page 1 ('a thin, low-profile 2.0mm pitch connector 8.0mm in height after mounting and 4.5mm in width') is the PH SERIES headline for the through-hole top-entry style, not this SKU. For S10B-PH-SM4-TB use the page-3 side-entry SMT figure: 5.5 mm high, 6 mm deep (plus a (2.6) reference), B = 23.9 mm long.

Applicable PC board thickness 0.8 to 1.6 mm (page 1). Circuit No.1 is marked on both the land-pattern drawing and the body figure; on the recommended layout it is at one end of the row, viewed from the component side.

Reel packaging: 1,000 pcs/reel, embossed tape (the 'Emboss Tape' badge on page 1 and the Q'ty/reel column on page 3). '-TB' is the taped/reeled suffix; '(LF)(SN)' is the lead-free tin label the product carries, per the RoHS compliance note.
